FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When you ask a question in French, what should your voice do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Become louder only
   B. Go down
   C. Stay silent
   D. Go up

2. What does 'salut' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. thank you
   C. hi, bye
   D. goodbye

3. How do you say 'My mother is called Grace.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   B. C'est ma sœur.
   C. C'est le bébé.
   D. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.

4. What does 'la fille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the baby
   B. the boy
   C. the grandfather
   D. the girl

5. What does 'la fenêtre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the window
   B. the bed
   C. the book
   D. the cat

6. What does 'devant' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. on
   B. between
   C. in
   D. in front of

7. What does 'vendredi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Monday
   C. Friday
   D. Tuesday

8. What does 'mardi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Friday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Sunday

9. What number is 'dix-neuf' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 8
   C. 14
   D. 19

10. How do you say 'It is the first of January.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est le premier janvier.
   B. Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?
   C. J'ai neuf ans.
   D. Joyeux anniversaire !

11. What does 'le thé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cake
   B. the banana
   C. rice
   D. tea

12. Fill in: Ce sont ______ mangues. (1 mark)
   A. une
   B. des
   C. un
   D. le

13. How do you say 'It is not good for your health.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   B. C'est un gâteau.
   C. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   D. J'aime le lait.

14. Fill in: J'ai ______ nez. (1) (1 mark)
   A. une
   B. un
   C. des
   D. deux

15. What does 'les yeux' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the eyes
   B. the head
   C. the back
   D. the knee

16. How do you say 'Touch your nose!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Touche ton nez !
   B. Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   C. Il est grand.
   D. J'ai une bouche.

17. What does 'Il fait chaud.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is freezing.
   B. It is hot.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is raining.

18. Fill in: Il ______ . (It is raining.) (1 mark)
   A. pleut
   B. y a pleut
   C. est pleut
   D. fait pleut

19. How do you say 'The cat is behind the door.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   B. Le chat est derrière la porte.
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. Il est sur la table.

20. What does 'tout droit' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the right
   B. straight ahead
   C. near
   D. to the left

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three sentences about foods you like and do not like in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Write five parts of the body in French with le, la or les. (5 marks) (5 marks)

23. Give three tips for listening for the gist of a message. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Write the three direction words for straight, left and right in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Explain why correct pronunciation is important when you speak French. Give one example of a sound that is different from English. (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Write three weather sentences in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. List four things you find at a birthday party in French with un or une. (4 marks) (4 marks)

28. Explain how to stay safe in harsh weather such as a storm. (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Write the French letter names for the name Kamau. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Go up
   A question ends with a rising voice.

2. C — hi, bye
   salut means hi, bye.

3. D — Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   My mother is called Grace. in French is Ma mère s'appelle Grace.

4. D — the girl
   la fille means the girl.

5. A — the window
   la fenêtre means the window.

6. D — in front of
   devant means in front of.

7. C — Friday
   vendredi means Friday.

8. C — Tuesday
   mardi means Tuesday.

9. D — 19
   dix-neuf means 19.

10. A — C'est le premier janvier.
   It is the first of January. in French is C'est le premier janvier.

11. D — tea
   le thé means tea.

12. B — des
   Des is used for many things.

13. A — Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   It is not good for your health. in French is Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.

14. B — un
   Nez is masculine, so un nez.

15. A — the eyes
   les yeux means the eyes.

16. A — Touche ton nez !
   Touch your nose! in French is Touche ton nez !

17. B — It is hot.
   Il fait chaud. means It is hot..

18. A — pleut
   We say Il pleut, without fait.

19. B — Le chat est derrière la porte.
   The cat is behind the door. in French is Le chat est derrière la porte.

20. B — straight ahead
   tout droit means straight ahead.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'aime la mangue. J'aime le lait. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: la tête, les yeux, le nez, la bouche, la main
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its article.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen for words you know; listen for the topic first; do not translate every word; listen again for details.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tip.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: tout droit, à gauche, à droite
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Correct pronunciation helps people understand you and shows respect for the language. For example, the letter j says zh, as in bonjour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for understanding, 1 mark for respect or communication, 1 mark for a correct example.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Il fait beau. Il pleut. Il y a du vent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: un gâteau, une bougie, un cadeau, un ballon
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its un or une.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay inside a strong building, stay away from tall trees and water, and listen to adults.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each safety point.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: ka, ah, em, ah, ü
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all five correct; lose 1 mark for every two mistakes.
